GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.testing_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, navigation links, quick-add triggers, modals, list rows, tabs, toggles) MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='add-expense-button', data-testid='revolut-balance-card', data-testid='ai-mic-trigger').
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.no_universal_transition: Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use explicit CSS transitions like transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.no_center_app_container: Do NOT center-align the app container. Align text naturally to left.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure high text contrast in both light and dark modes. Avoid light grey text on light cards. Headers must have non-transparent backgrounds.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.skeleton_loaders: Use elegant animated skeleton placeholders (pulse bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded) while fetching data — never plain spinners.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for toasts located in src/components/ui/sonner.js or sonner.jsx with clear status feedback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json to guide all visual and interactive development.
Implement the app in React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Shadcn components.
Build the single-user experience customized for Sá with persistent local state or backend database.

Provide seamless tab switching between Home Command Center, Money/Finance, Shared & Reimbursements, Groceries, Nutrition, Fitness/Calisthenics, Body & Progress Photos, Tasks, Calendar, AI Assistant, and Settings.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have proper data-testid attributes.
